queryProtocol.goal: Use exact source wording, not summaries or assumptions.
order: Read the requested female's episode-specific JSON.
Locate person in character_name_index. This is an explicit-mention locator, not a claim of consent, presence or direct interaction.
For each matching scene, read the entire scene's prose_line_records in original order. Continue beyond name-matching lines because nearby pronoun turns may matter.
For byte-for-byte source recall, reconstruct source_html_lines_exact with newline; no content is omitted or paraphrased.
Filter scene.approved_by_source_plan, approved_by_ui_or_plan or approved_by_ui_label only when user explicitly requests approved-only results.
If an episode or scene is missing, say the source is missing. Do not reconstruct prose from a plan, image or memory.
If speaker or pronoun referent is ambiguous, quote exact passage and state ambiguity. Never invent who is speaking, who is physically present, or whether contact was consensual.

updatePolicy.exactUserIntent: After each episode, update these JSON files when I tell you to update them.
updatePolicy.cadence: After episode completion, user-commanded, never automatic
updatePolicy.expectedAction: Fetch latest approved GitHub source, compare against prior archived JSON, preserve unchanged scene records, append/update only grounded changed source text, rebuild name/speaker index, record source blob SHA and verification.
